#Aletheia #Politics

Stockbridge Mayor Jayden Williams was impeached and removed after 10 months following allegations of financial misuse and inappropriate communication.

The poison is the dangerous precedent of weaponizing administrative rules to overturn democratic mandates over unproven personal accusations.
Confusing personal conduct (WHO) with legal impeachment standards (HOW). Using administrative cards as a pretext for a political hit.

Council members executed a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using minor financial errors as a pretext to oust an unwanted rival through projected moral outrage.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public officials must maintain strict separation between personal and municipal funds.

The Unavoidable Lie: Impeachment without criminal conviction is always free of political bias.
